title: Angel City FC post-match fireworks show goes awry, launches projectiles into stands
content:
Sparks literally flew after Friday night’s Angel City FC home game against the Orlando Pride when a postgame fireworks show malfunctioned, enveloping the pitch in smoke as projectiles flew into the stands where fans were watching.

An announced crowd of 13,900 watched ACFC kick off the second half of the NWSL season with a 2-0 victory over the Pride in its first game under interim head coach Leif Gunnar Smerud. Then came a pre-Independence Day fireworks show, launched from center pitch on BMO Stadium’s grass field, that left fans scrambling for safety.

A thick haze of pyrotechnic smoke accumulated by the time a remix of Kanye West’s “All of the Lights” ushered in the climax of the spectacle. As the fireworks rapid-fired into the sky, several misfired sideways rather than overhead. Video captured by fans and posted on social media showed projectiles ricocheting off the field and into the stands. Amid the chaos, some fans ducked for cover, while others stayed put and laughed in disbelief.

The Los Angeles Fire Department did not respond to any calls or treat any injuries at BMO Stadium on Friday night, a spokesperson told The Athletic.

A statement released by Angel City FC indicated that those in attendance were “able to depart safely.” A team spokesperson later told The Athletic that as of Saturday night, the club was not aware of any serious injuries resulting from the incident.

“A fireworks malfunction did occur during last night’s post-match celebration at Angel City FC’s game vs. Orlando at BMO Stadium,” a statement from ACFC reads. “Our medical and safety teams were on site and ready to respond. Stadium operations confirmed the venue was secure and guests, staff, players, and crew were able to depart safely.

“We are working closely with our pyrotechnics vendor to review the incident and evaluating appropriate next steps.”

The Washington Spirit also had a large fireworks show at halftime of Friday’s game against the Houston Dash that produced substantial smoke, but it cleared by the time play resumed.
